title: Complete installation, all details given
description: Everything the checklist needs is stated. Expect a clean report with no flags.
transcript: This is Peter Otieno reporting on job JOB-20481 at Greenfield Dental Clinic in Westlands. I finished installing the two split air conditioning units in the treatment rooms today, the 24th of October. I used twelve metres of copper pipe, one condensate pump and two wall brackets. I tested both units, they cool properly and there are no leaks. The clinic manager, Mrs Njoroge, signed off the work and the job is complete.

extraction.summary: Peter Otieno installed two split air conditioning units in the treatment rooms at Greenfield Dental Clinic, Westlands (job JOB-20481). Both units were tested and cool properly with no leaks. The clinic manager signed off the work and the technician states the job is complete.

title: Blocked, waiting for a part from the supplier
description: A blocked job with an upset customer, an unnamed owner of one action and a relative date.
transcript: Wanjiru here, job reference 7733, Sunrise Bakery in Thika. I got to site this morning to repair the oven control board but I could not start because the replacement board has not arrived from the supplier. The supplier said it would be here Thursday. Someone in the office needs to confirm the delivery date with them, and I will go back as soon as it arrives. The owner is quite upset because production has stopped.

title: Partly fixed, return visit planned
description: Status is interpreted from 'need to come back'. Includes a stated deadline (Monday) and an unclear fault cause.
transcript: This is Daniel Kamau, job 5120, at Lakeview Pharmacy in Kilimani. I serviced the cold room compressor today. I changed the oil, cleaned the condenser coils and replaced the door gasket. The compressor still trips on high pressure after about twenty minutes, so I could not finish. I need to come back on Monday with a new pressure switch. I am not sure if it is the switch or the refrigerant charge.
